tasks.question: Do B hybrid/family duplicate votes dilute an ensemble, and does pre-target ticket geometry provide a better weighting control?
tasks.novelty: Controlled B-ticket ensemble ablation: remove frequency-gap hybrid, merge semantic relationship family, or weight current forecast overlap. Prior V3 used different batch001 rank/portfolio models; prior dynamic study selected single B components.

tasks.question: Does nested 3+ or 4+ selection of overlap-weighted ensembles improve the high-hit tail compared with fixed equal weighting?
tasks.novelty: Select ensemble redundancy exponents, not component identity. Four pre-frozen exponents are evaluated on 200 preceding out-of-sample targets; 3+/4+ objectives remain separate from prior mean/2+ selector research.

tasks.question: How much confirmatory data is required for 3+/4+ effect sizes at a prespecified family error rate?
tasks.novelty: Exact high-tail power at 1.5x/2x uniform rates and several sample sizes; a study of verification sufficiency, not another Monte Carlo baseline or frequency report. Standard-library independent fallback.
